The appeal path, quoted from POL-GEN-04

Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 6.75 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

The judge's explanation, as written

To the rider and to the driver: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee (EV-FARE-02713, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is refunded to the rider in full, and the platform pays the driver SGD 2.25 as a platform-funded goodwill payment. The rider pays nothing. The fee is not chargeable. A no-show fee requires the driver to have reached the pickup point (POL-NS-01(b)). The GPS trace EV-GPS-02713 never places the driver inside the 120 m arrival radius for this LARGE_VENUE pickup (EV-TRIP-02713.pickup_zone_class = LARGE_VENUE): over 73 fixes his closest approach is 227.26 m, and the derived arrival test returns 0 qualifying in-radius fixes with a longest qualifying run of 0.0 s. Under POL-NS-02 the driver therefore never arrived and POL-NS-01(b) fails. The effective in-geofence dwell is 0 s against the 180 s free waiting period in force (EV-TRIP-02713.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a shortfall of 180.0 s, so POL-NS-06 independently requires the fee to be refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she answered messages. The driver's 'I'm Here' tap at 07:35:42 does not start the clock: POL-NS-01(c) runs the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and there is none. The arrival marker in force is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO, so POL-NS-12 does not give the platform's arrival and wait-timer events independent carrier status. The driver is nonetheless paid, and the platform bears that cost rather than the rider. His closest position, 227.26 m, lies outside the 120 m arrival radius but inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, and he held position there through the 330 s between his 07:35:42 arrival tap and his 07:41:12 cancellation. POL-NS-03, to which POL-NS-02 expressly yields, therefore governs who absorbs the cost. Neither party named an entrance, block, tower or bay in EV-CHAT-02713 ('im here'; 'cant see you'; 'im here already, where are you'), and the venue carries 3 registered pickup points (EV-TRIP-02713.registered_pickup_points), so POL-NS-03(ii) attributes the mislocation to pin ambiguity rather than to either party and awards the driver a platform-funded goodwill payment of 50 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee = SGD 2.25, charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider. Under POL-GEN-03 that payment and the rider's refund are independent and are never netted against each other. POL-NS-07's 80 percent payout of SGD 3.60 is not payable, because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full; and the driver's statement that he waited 'at the pickup bay' is only partly borne out: he never reached the pin (closest approach 227.26 m, trip mean 1547.34 m), which is why the fee is refunded, but he was stationary within 400 m, which is what POL-NS-03 reads. POL-NS-05 is not engaged: the closest approach of 227.26 m is inside its 300 m mark, and nothing in the trace places the driver more than 300 m out, or moving at 15 km/h or more, at the arrival tap, so no false-arrival referral arises. The rider's own track (EV-GPS-02713, 70 of 70 qualifying fixes, 16.06 to 23.13 m from the pin) confirms she was at the pickup, but POL-NS-04 does not exonerate her and strip the driver: the driver replied at 07:38:12 to her 07:37:22 message, 50 s later and inside the 120 s window, so POL-NS-04 limb (b) fails and the clause does not apply. EV-ADVIS-02713-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. It can carry no fact, and its absence closes POL-NS-06(i)'s accumulation route (the trace also shows 0 in-geofence intervals to sum), but it carries no deciding fact here: it neither caps nor changes this outcome, which rests on EV-GPS-02713 and EV-TRIP-02713, both at weight 1.0. No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is engaged: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1 (below 3), both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0 (below 2), and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 1 is below 4, and 1 divided by 60 = 0.017 is below 0.08). The apparent conflict between the trip record's arrival event and the trace is resolved by POL-NS-03, so POL-NS-09(b) does not apply and the case is decided, not held. The monetary effect is SGD 6.75 (the SGD 4.50 refund plus the SGD 2.25 goodwill), which is below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold of POL-GEN-05, so the ruling executes on issue, subject to appeal under POL-GEN-04. Confidence is 0.90, at the 1.0 cap set by the two weight-1.0 artifacts that carry the deciding facts. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

What each side argued

The rider advocate

kept POL-NS-02 deems a driver arrived only where the trace holds at least 3 consecutive fixes inside the arrival radius — 120 m for a LARGE_VENUE pickup such as this one. This trace holds none. Across the whole pickup attempt the driver's 73 fixes never came closer to the pin than 227.26 m, roughly twice the radius, and the derived arrival block returns 0 qualifying fixes with a longest qualifying run of 0.0 s. POL-NS-01 limb (b) therefore fails on the driver's own telemetry, the fee is not chargeable, and the whole contested amount — the $4.50 cancellation-fee line the ledger shows charged with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 — is refunded to the rider.

evidence EV-GPS-02713, EV-TRIP-02713, EV-FARE-02713 · clauses POL-NS-02, POL-NS-01

kept The 328 seconds between the driver's 'I'm Here' tap at 07:35:42 and his cancellation at 07:41:12 cannot carry the fee, because POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and expressly not from the 'arrived' event. On this trip there is no qualifying in-geofence fix at all: the longest qualifying run is 0.0 s and the recommended dwell start offset is null. The waiting clock never started on the only basis the policy recognises.

evidence EV-TRIP-02713, EV-GPS-02713 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-06

kept The shortfall arithmetic is decisive under POL-NS-06. The free waiting period in force is 180 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec as POL-NS-01(c) requires ahead of any default; the measured effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds; the derived shortfall is 180.0 s. The fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider answered messages.

evidence EV-GPS-02713, EV-TRIP-02713, EV-FARE-02713 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-NS-01

kept The accumulation route in POL-NS-06(i) is closed to the driver. It operates only where the trace shows in-geofence intervals to sum, and this trace shows 0 such intervals and a run count of 0, so there is nothing to accumulate; and it additionally requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated over the pickup road. I disclose that EV-ADVIS-02713-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so it can carry no fact — but its absence is itself citable, and POL-NS-06(i)'s own terms make limb (i) unavailable where no such advisory exists.

evidence EV-ADVIS-02713-01, EV-GPS-02713 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-GEN-02

kept The driver's statement that he 'waited at the pickup bay the app sent me to' is contradicted by the driver's own track. His mean distance from the pickup pin across the 73 fixes is 1,547.34 m, his closest approach in the entire trip is 227.26 m, and the window records road speeds up to 62.7 km/h. A track that never enters the 120 m arrival radius and averages over a kilometre and a half from the pin does not describe a driver parked at the bay.

evidence EV-GPS-02713, EV-TRIP-02713 · clauses POL-NS-02, POL-NS-01

kept The record establishes where the rider was, which is the pin. The rider's track returns 70 of 70 qualifying fixes inside the 150 m rider presence radius for a LARGE_VENUE zone, ranging from 16.06 m to 23.13 m from the pickup pin, every one of them at 0.0 km/h, for the whole window in which the driver cancelled. The rider's in-app message 'cant see you' at 07:37:22 is consistent with that and with nothing on the driver's side coming nearer than 227 m. I cite POL-NS-04 for the presence radius it sets for this zone class; I do not rest this claim on POL-NS-04's exoneration test, which also requires limb (b), and the driver's 07:38:12 reply falls inside the 120 second window that limb (b) sets.

evidence EV-GPS-02713, EV-CHAT-02713 · clauses POL-NS-04, POL-NS-02

kept POL-NS-12 gives the platform's own arrival and wait-timer events independent carrier status only where trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO. On this trip the arrival marker in force is BUTTON — the driver pressed it — so the 'I'm Here' event and the wait-timer start carry no arrival finding of their own and remain subject to the POL-NS-02 proximity test and POL-NS-05, both of which are answered by the trace: 0 qualifying in-radius fixes and a minimum distance of 227.26 m.

evidence EV-TRIP-02713, EV-GPS-02713 · clauses POL-NS-12, POL-NS-01

kept No driver compensation is payable. POL-NS-07 compensates a driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; limb (b) here fails outright and POL-NS-06 independently refunds the fee, so the 3.60 figure carried in the fare ledger's derived money block has no clause to stand on. The rider should not fund any part of this trip.

evidence EV-FARE-02713, EV-GPS-02713 · clauses POL-NS-07, POL-NS-01

kept This case is decidable and should be decided, not escalated. POL-NS-09(d) reads rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, which is 1 and not the 3 that limb requires; limb (c) needs 2 or more no-show disputes between the same rider and driver in 90 days and both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0. None of the escalation triggers is engaged, and escalation under POL-GEN-03 would only hold the fee rather than return it.

evidence EV-RPROF-02713, EV-DPROF-02713 · clauses POL-NS-09, POL-GEN-03

The driver advocate

kept This is a POL-NS-03 wrong-face case, not a POL-NS-02 case of a driver who never came to the venue. The driver's own trace never places him closer than 227.26 m to the pickup pin — outside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius, but inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling — and the rider's own account says he was 'somewhere else in the complex', not that he stayed away. The platform's own record has him marking arrival at 07:35:42, starting the 180 s free-wait timer at 07:35:44 and holding until he cancelled at 07:41:12, a 5.5-minute wait, with two 'im here' messages in between. POL-NS-02 states in terms that where the driver was stationary for the required dwell within 400 m of the pin, POL-NS-03 governs the outcome including the driver's compensation and this clause yields to it.

evidence EV-GPS-02713, EV-TRIP-02713, EV-CHAT-02713 · clauses POL-NS-03, POL-NS-02

kept On POL-NS-03's fault allocation the driver is owed money. Neither party named an entrance, block, tower or bay: the driver wrote only 'im here' and 'im here already, where are you', and the rider only 'cant see you'. This pickup carries 3 registered pickup points at a LARGE_VENUE, so under POL-NS-03 limb (ii) the mislocation is attributed to pin ambiguity rather than to either party, and the driver receives the platform-funded goodwill payment of 50 percent of the cancellation fee in force: 0.50 x SGD 4.50 = SGD 2.25, charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider. Under POL-GEN-03 that payment and the rider's refund are independent and are never netted against each other.

evidence EV-CHAT-02713, EV-TRIP-02713, EV-FARE-02713 · clauses POL-NS-03, POL-GEN-03

kept POL-NS-06 does not defeat that payment. POL-NS-03 is the clause that decides who absorbs the cost on these facts, and it licenses DRIVER_COMPENSATION; POL-NS-06 runs only on an 'effective in-geofence dwell' computed under POL-NS-02, and POL-NS-02 has expressly yielded this case to POL-NS-03, so the shortfall arithmetic is never reached. POL-NS-06's sentence that no driver compensation is payable speaks to the fee-funded payout POL-NS-07 would make out of the cancellation fee; it does not reach the platform-funded goodwill POL-NS-03(ii) creates, which is charged to the platform.

evidence EV-FARE-02713, EV-GPS-02713, EV-TRIP-02713 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-NS-03, POL-NS-07

kept POL-NS-04 cannot be used to exonerate the rider and strip the driver: limb (b) fails because the driver did answer inside the 120-second window — the rider's 'cant see you' at 07:37:22 was followed by the driver's reply at 07:38:12, 50 seconds later — and POL-NS-04 states that where the driver did reply within 120 seconds the clause does not apply regardless of the content of the reply. No in-app call was needed and none was made.

evidence EV-CHAT-02713, EV-TRIP-02713 · clauses POL-NS-04

kept Nothing on this record warrants escalation, and the driver's entitlement should be ruled on rather than held: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3 that POL-NS-09 reads, there are no counterparty disputes in either direction, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is not tripped by driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d = 1 against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d = 60 (1 is below 4, and 1/60 = 0.017 is below 0.08). The artifacts the driver relies on — the trace, the trip record and the chat log — are all COMPLETE at weight 1.0.

evidence EV-RPROF-02713, EV-DPROF-02713, EV-GPS-02713, EV-TRIP-02713, EV-CHAT-02713 · clauses POL-NS-09, POL-NS-07, POL-GEN-01
